entries.text: (The "challenger who can't take the final step" mentioned in the surface theme is actually myself.)
entries.label: ebe15285
entries.speaker: _in_otoshi

entries.text: Because this song has such a background story, when I received the acceptance notification, of course I was extremely happy.
entries.label: 9d674c7e
entries.speaker: _in_otoshi

entries.text: At the same time, I felt that the"step" I took was finally rewarded, and I recalled that feeling of relief I had at that moment.
entries.label: d2de666d
entries.speaker: _in_otoshi

entries.text: For me, this song represents a breakthrough and a turning point in my growth as an artist.
entries.label: 171b8e1c
entries.speaker: _in_otoshi

entries.text: So there's a story behind it…!
entries.label: 388b155a
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Indeed, nothing ever starts unless you take that first step!
entries.label: 799f67ff
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Besides that, is there anything else you'd like to share with the pilots, Mr. otoshi.b?
entries.label: a686219a
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Once again, thank you all very much. I'm truly happy that my song was chosen for the competition and that everyone can enjoy it!
entries.label: 8823cc86
entries.speaker: _in_otoshi

entries.text: Based on these experiences, this track is also deeply emotional for me.
entries.label: 3202c2c7
entries.speaker: _in_otoshi

entries.text: If everyone can enjoy it, I would be extremely honored!! Please continue to support me!!
entries.label: 83e2d970
entries.speaker: _in_otoshi

entries.text: We're back at our interview location again!
entries.label: c2d4cdd5
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: This time, we have a duo with us! Could both of you please start by introducing yourselves?
entries.label: 7bbd6d65
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I'm Moon Jelly, but you can call me Jelly! (˵>ᗜ<˵) !!
entries.label: 91cb1b0b
entries.speaker: _in_moonj

entries.text: This was the first song we've ever made together, which makes me even happier the work was chosen by the Rotaeno team!
entries.label: 39e72f7
entries.speaker: _in_moonj

entries.text: Haha, it seems like you two have quite different personalities. Welcome!
entries.label: fa10992d
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Could you please introduce your new song, "ALL☆NIGHTER!" to us?
entries.label: 550eb92b
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Though it was my first time participating in a rhythm game song contest, I'm mostly known for my Eurobeat arrangements,
entries.label: 36b06d8f
entries.speaker: _in_turbo

entries.text: so of course our song, ALL☆NIGHTER！ had to be Eurobeat.
entries.label: 710b8a75
entries.speaker: _in_turbo

entries.text: Not that you'd know how to make anything else!
entries.label: 4b668307
entries.speaker: _in_moonj

entries.text: Besides, what would fit better for a game with mechanics like "drifting" and "flicking"
entries.label: 248d661e
entries.speaker: _in_moonj

entries.text: Eurobeat used to be a premier genre in rhythm gaming,
entries.label: 5fa62ab0
entries.speaker: _in_turbo

entries.text: but it has fallen out of favor in the recent years due to artists not really making it anymore,
entries.label: 89040b7c
entries.speaker: _in_turbo

entries.text: so I wanted to bring a beloved genre back for the players who still love it!
entries.label: 9195fdd7
entries.speaker: _in_turbo

entries.text: When I first heard of Rotaeno, it was through the song "On And On!!" by ETIA.
entries.label: 6184a3b1
entries.speaker: _in_turbo

entries.text: and hearing such a brilliant track with a Eurobeat influenced riff really spoke to me!
entries.label: 1193c580
entries.speaker: _in_turbo

entries.text: Since I was working with a very talented vocalist, my dream of bringing the denpa eurobeat style into life in english was wonderfully realized.
entries.label: fe23aa54
entries.speaker: _in_turbo

entries.text: I also wanted to modernize the style, so despite its retro roots, it would still sound fresh today!
entries.label: ca658b15
entries.speaker: _in_turbo

entries.text: It also tells a very familiar story from modern day, doesn't it?
entries.label: 709861c9
entries.speaker: _in_moonj

entries.text: We always worked on the song at the worst times imaginable!
entries.label: db2c2304
entries.speaker: _in_turbo

entries.text: I can't be alone in never getting any work done during the day, right?
entries.label: 6aba7b99
entries.speaker: _in_moonj

entries.text: Didn't you send an update on the arrangement at 6am?
entries.label: bff1cefe
entries.speaker: _in_moonj

entries.text: You guys' routines sound a bit worrying, honestly…
entries.label: 872feb1b
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Anyway, please make sure to take care of your health!
entries.label: 6e0011e
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: So, before we wrap things up, is there anything you'd like to say to our pilots?
entries.label: a18ec694
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: We would like to thank you for listening to our song!
entries.label: 653a50fe
entries.speaker: _in_turbo

entries.text: We also want to thank all the staff involved for making the song into a complete rhythm game work.
entries.label: dd58d389
entries.speaker: _in_turbo

entries.text: It would still be just a sound file on my hard drive if not for the artist(s) creating a jacket to catch the eyes of the players, and the charter(s) mapping the song for the players to play,
entries.label: c9097879
entries.speaker: _in_turbo

entries.text: and of course, the Rotaeno team for choosing the song among so many other brilliant entries and making it all possible and bringing the work to life!
entries.label: eb102040
entries.speaker: _in_turbo

entries.text: Otherwise, it might still just be an audio file sitting on my hard drive.
entries.label: a9f2bfb0
entries.speaker: _in_turbo

entries.text: Rhythm games are fun, Rotaeno is fun, so we wanted to make a really fun song!
entries.label: d290c4c8
entries.speaker: _in_moonj

entries.text: I just hope the song is challenging enough that the players don't get bored of me... uuu...
entries.label: ac55f8ff
entries.speaker: _in_moonj

entries.text: Could you please introduce yourself first?
entries.label: 94882f1e
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Hello, nice to meet you all. I'm Zexnum!
entries.label: 20b7826d
entries.speaker: _in_zexnum

entries.text: I'm super excited about your new song "Call My Number." Can you tell us a little bit about it?
entries.label: 234b6751
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I'm really into rhythm games myself.
entries.label: 9043e853
entries.speaker: _in_zexnum

entries.text: it's very meaningful to me to have my music featured in Rotaeno in this way.
entries.label: 3d6fb088
entries.speaker: _in_zexnum

entries.text: Rather than being the typical kind of track you'd hear in rhythm games,
entries.label: a10820ab
entries.speaker: _in_zexnum

entries.text: this piece incorporates EDM and house music elements, giving it more of a nightclub feel.
entries.label: 8f377654
entries.speaker: _in_zexnum

entries.text: I'm confident that EDM fans are really going to love this track,
entries.label: 4100ce50
entries.speaker: _in_zexnum

entries.text: so please give it a go on every difficulty level—I'd be thrilled if you enjoy it!
entries.label: 6b45e334
entries.speaker: _in_zexnum

entries.text: It sounds like it's going to be a really fun track!
entries.label: 24798a98
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Do you have any messages you want to share with the players?
entries.label: ad5d6dd6
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Thank you so much to all the Rotaeno players for playing my song!
entries.label: a571d8e2
entries.speaker: _in_zexnum

entries.text: I'll be working hard to beat all the difficulties too, so let's enjoy the game together!
entries.label: 1718da83
entries.speaker: _in_zexnum

entries.text: Welcome to the interview! Could you please introduce yourself to everyone?
entries.label: 94ff8ac9
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Hello!! My name is ItsMeFisher and I am a newcomer composer in rhythm games!
entries.label: f47a5fe6
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: It must be very exciting to be able to hear your own work in Rotaeno, right?
entries.label: 1e3cb74a
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Could you share your original creative ideas with us?
entries.label: 9b5ab04
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: This is my first song in any commercial rhythm game!
entries.label: 8c87c24e
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: his is also my first time getting selected in a song contest,
entries.label: d11f2be5
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: so a massive thank you to the Rotaeno team for giving me this opportunity!
entries.label: 1ea76d1f
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: I heard that the inspiration for this song is related to Rotaeno's world and lore!
entries.label: d581eb11
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Could you tell us a bit more about it?
entries.label: eafec2fd
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: During the creation of this song,
entries.label: 2843555d
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: I tried to fit the song into Rotaeno's story / world view
entries.label: e8d6391c
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: and capture what it would feel like to pilot a spaceship through space
entries.label: cd5cc753
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: which is why this song is named Cosmic Voyage.
entries.label: 64cb7334
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: Wow! Spaceships are really cool — and by the way!
entries.label: 5516cb88
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: This song seems to be a bit slower than most rhythm game songs. Was that intentional?
entries.label: d95b621b
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: The genre of this song is Midtempo at 110 BPM,
entries.label: bc404b58
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: which is one of my favorite genres but is very uncommon in rhythm games.
entries.label: 537a711c
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: I believe slow songs in rhythm games have a unique appeal:
entries.label: 5ded2880
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: compared to the faster songs, slow songs have the capacity
entries.label: b05dbeb4
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: to show how itself and the game is special.
entries.label: 79551e49
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: To me, listening to a slow song feels just like listening to someone telling me a story.
entries.label: e5fc888
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: In fact, the essence of some rhythm games is contained in slow songs.
entries.label: 6a210c9f
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: This is also partly the reason why I approached the creation of this song with the story of Rotaeno in mind.
entries.label: a8f6951e
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: How romantic...! So, do you have any words for the players?
entries.label: c3e701ec
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Thank you so much for listening and playing!
entries.label: 14816d57
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: Also, huge thanks to the artist(s) for creating such a cool jacket
entries.label: 3f571e8d
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: as well as the charter(s) for making such a fun chart!
entries.label: 9e19ab7c
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: If you liked this song, I am truly honored!
entries.label: 4cf6687
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: I will keep improving and composing songs in the future!
entries.label: b3f4eb37
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: Thank you for agreeing to this interview!
entries.label: 640bee7c
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Incidentally, we've heard some players comment that the music feels a bit slow.
entries.label: c417af51
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: What are your thoughts on that?
entries.label: 9eead2ab
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: If you thought this song was too slow, then uhh…
entries.label: 4edd3fff
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: Play this song at two times speed
entries.label: 8c1ac3b3
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: and you will get a song at 220 BPM!
entries.label: 21c00854
entries.speaker: _in_fisher

entries.text: Welcome to the interview room! Please introduce yourself to everyone.
entries.label: 23cd138
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Dxsbond, newer in the scene of music licensed for games,
entries.label: fe19a78a
entries.speaker: _in_dxsbond

entries.text: but producing electronic music for 6 years.
entries.label: 7d668c51
entries.speaker: _in_dxsbond

entries.text: It's a pleasure to meet you!
entries.label: 6e6160ba
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Could you please tell us about your newly released song "Dispersion"?
entries.label: 15931ff
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I named it after the fact that,
entries.label: 648053a6
entries.speaker: _in_dxsbond

entries.text: I used the fx plugin disperser about a million times in the song haha.
entries.label: b3de6699
entries.speaker: _in_dxsbond

entries.text: It was a really fun song to make,
entries.label: 855ab45c
entries.speaker: _in_dxsbond

entries.text: I feel like it's one of the rarer instances where I am able to step away from conventional composition and formatting,
entries.label: 8bbf8abf
entries.speaker: _in_dxsbond

entries.text: and come up with something "new" in my head.
entries.label: b69e40b5
entries.speaker: _in_dxsbond

entries.text: I'm super glad I get an opportunity to share my music with a wide audience,
entries.label: 9c13deae
entries.speaker: _in_dxsbond

entries.text: since this has been my dream since I initially started music.
entries.label: df9610c1
entries.speaker: _in_dxsbond

entries.text: Wait, a million times?! That sounds both impressive and really interesting...
entries.label: 6591fdeb
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: So, is there anything you'd like to say to the players?
entries.label: cce07d5
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I think the number one thing to remember as a musician is to always do what you want!
entries.label: 93b815d6
entries.speaker: _in_dxsbond

entries.text: If you start limiting yourself based on how profitable you think,
entries.label: 320a27c8
entries.speaker: _in_dxsbond

entries.text: something is then you will eventually lose interest in your art.
entries.label: 5c0290dc
entries.speaker: _in_dxsbond

entries.text: Just have fun with it at the end of the day.
entries.label: e18d566a
entries.speaker: _in_dxsbond

entries.text: I make various kinds of music, including rhythm game music, of course!
entries.speaker: _in_raphiie

entries.text: Can you introduce your new song, "enter -MAGICAL CODE-" in detail?
entries.label: 11a17e49
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: "enter -MAGICAL CODE-" is a Tech Core track infused with oriental vibes and retro 8-bit elements.
entries.label: d45f184c
entries.speaker: _in_raphiie

entries.text: It tells the story of a player who discovers a mysterious machine.
entries.label: e0f88fa7
entries.speaker: _in_raphiie

entries.text: When activating the machine, it malfunctions, throwing the player into random dimensions.
entries.label: d4e03681
entries.speaker: _in_raphiie

entries.text: To fix it, the player must enter a "magical code" to return home.
entries.label: 678750ac
entries.speaker: _in_raphiie

entries.text: I'm so happy that this song was chosen as one of the winners in the Rotaeno music contest.
entries.label: b91df215
entries.speaker: _in_raphiie

entries.text: Huge thanks to the Rotaeno team for this amazing opportunity!
entries.label: 48a17cc2
entries.speaker: _in_raphiie

entries.text: The mysterious machine sounds so intriguing!
entries.label: 5b434ff2
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: What were your thoughts when composing this track?
entries.label: be591166
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Have you ever imagined a song that could take you to places you've never even dreamed of?
entries.label: 7f20695c
entries.speaker: _in_raphiie

entries.text: Like tasting all sorts of candy flavors, each one giving you a completely new experience?
entries.label: 4195d0fd
entries.speaker: _in_raphiie

entries.text: That's exactly what I envisioned when creating this track.
entries.label: 767ff64f
entries.speaker: _in_raphiie

entries.text: I wanted to make a song with a sense of "randomness" that keeps listeners guessing, "What's going to happen next?"
entries.label: 1668020f
entries.speaker: _in_raphiie

entries.text: It seems like players will have a fun journey while playing this song!
entries.label: fe725f5b
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Does this song have any other unique features?
entries.label: e5a160cf
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Oh~ you can actually find the magical code hidden somewhere in this track, try to find it~
entries.label: 29cb37d5
entries.speaker: _in_raphiie

entries.text: Clue: It's a simple word, and it's related to rotate.
entries.label: 8bec7ae8
entries.speaker: _in_raphiie

entries.text: So, the code is actually within the song!
entries.label: 6248b02d
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Lastly, do you have anything you'd like to say to the players?
entries.label: 60e6ee3c
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Thank you so much for listening to my work!
entries.label: c6e19efc
entries.speaker: _in_raphiie

entries.text: I'm happy if you enjoyed the experience and the adventure this track offers.
entries.label: 41e014c6
entries.speaker: _in_raphiie

entries.text: I hope you'll look forward to my future works as well!
entries.label: 8245ea41
entries.speaker: _in_raphiie

entries.text: Welcome back to our interview! Hello, could you please introduce yourself to everyone?
entries.label: 417c7072
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Hello!!!! I'm ぴれんどらー, and I'm here in Rotaeno this time!
entries.label: 75901e7a
entries.speaker: _in_pirendor

entries.text: Mr.ぴれんどらー, you sound really excited!
entries.label: aef6d546
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Could you tell us about your new track, "ephemeralization"?
entries.label: c680e1ff
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: First of all, I'd like to express my sincere thanks to the Rotaeno team for selecting my song
entries.label: b241de5d
entries.speaker: _in_pirendor

entries.text: (I was so happy that almost crying)!
entries.label: 988c2f58
entries.speaker: _in_pirendor

entries.text: it's a hardcore track with an other-worldly atmosphere.
entries.label: 2f505bfe
entries.speaker: _in_pirendor

entries.text: My aim was to create a blend of intensity, brevity, and an illusory feeling,
entries.label: 9654d6da
entries.speaker: _in_pirendor

entries.text: and the title itself comes from the word "ephemeral".
entries.label: 3e577db2
entries.speaker: _in_pirendor

entries.text: I think I managed to write a melody
entries.label: b9afb2e
entries.speaker: _in_pirendor

entries.text: that really feels "ephemeral", both in the intro and the chorus.
entries.label: 8d9ba992
entries.speaker: _in_pirendor

entries.text: The track also features a high‑BPM drop that's very typical of rhythm games—
entries.label: 4d7a70aa
entries.speaker: _in_pirendor

entries.text: It's truly a very powerful song!
entries.label: 6a5b7d10
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I really enjoy both making and listening to tracks in this style,
entries.label: 4d19ab7
entries.speaker: _in_pirendor

entries.text: and it's honestly one of my favorite genres.
entries.label: d95b2278
entries.speaker: _in_pirendor

entries.text: Being able to bring this genre into a commercial rhythm game
entries.label: c6a0470d
entries.speaker: _in_pirendor

entries.text: Now then, is there anything you'd like to say to all the Rotaeno players?
entries.label: bb6c93fc
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Hello to all Rotaeno players, it's nice to meet you for the first time!
entries.label: f6ea26ab
entries.speaker: _in_pirendor

entries.text: I'm ぴれんどらー—what do you think of my track?
entries.label: 3892a4c3
entries.speaker: _in_pirendor

entries.text: If you enjoy it, that would make me really happy!
entries.label: f26c3ee6
entries.speaker: _in_pirendor

entries.text: I'm also incredibly grateful to the Rotaeno team for creating such awesome charts and artwork for my song,
entries.label: 68573a32
entries.speaker: _in_pirendor

entries.text: it honestly moved me so much!
entries.label: 5a4911a0
entries.speaker: _in_pirendor

entries.text: I'll keep writing more hardcore tracks with that otherworldly vibe, so please continue to support me!!
entries.label: 156b37dc
entries.speaker: _in_pirendor

entries.text: To start, could you all give a brief self-introduction?
entries.label: 3a9ff4ba
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I don't think I'd live in a world without steak.
entries.label: c729233c
entries.speaker: _in_moonj_he

entries.text: My usual doneness is medium-rare, and my favourite cut is probably filet mignon or skirt.
entries.label: cccff5a5
entries.speaker: _in_moonj_he

entries.text: Ah, but YAKINIKU is also amazing.
entries.label: 9f651cd8
entries.speaker: _in_moonj_he

entries.text: I love YAKINIKU, especially with leaner cuts of meat.
entries.label: 6c19d8c8
entries.speaker: _in_moonj_he

entries.text: I live in a world without steak.
entries.speaker: _in_aqua

entries.text: I think I'm allergic to most meats.
entries.label: d0adf1f4
entries.speaker: _in_aqua

entries.text: Not only do I have some sort of awful reaction, but I think I have some sort of meat curse.
entries.label: 43e2dbbb
entries.speaker: _in_aqua

entries.text: In university I got an A on every exam, except for when I had red meat.
entries.label: 17d1fa56
entries.speaker: _in_aqua

entries.text: Last time I had a burger we had to rush my grandma to the hospital.
entries.label: 8674ae7b
entries.speaker: _in_aqua

entries.text: The first 14 years of my life were spent in a dark room with a big glowing button labeled "DISPENSE MEAT CURSE".
entries.label: 4deeb87b
entries.speaker: _in_memo

entries.text: I loved to press that button because it made a really loud "clunk" sound if I pressed it hard enough.
entries.label: 1c9c4fd
entries.speaker: _in_memo

entries.text: Hmm… looks like you all have some interesting thoughts when it comes to meat!
entries.label: 8fbd7e07
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Could you give us a detailed introduction to your latest track, "HARMONIC EVASION 101"?
entries.label: 45631dbd
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I wish I could have screamed "I LOVE MEAT!" throughout the whole song, but this is good too.
entries.label: ca5c31c6
entries.speaker: _in_moonj_he

entries.text: While working on this song, I thought about how computer tutorial videos don't usually have very much jazz harmony.
entries.label: 49739e3f
entries.speaker: _in_aqua

entries.text: My favorite restaurant closes at 9PM so if I'm gonna order something to eat, I have to make sure that I order it by at least 8:30ish, that way I have enough time to go and pick it up before the place closes.
entries.label: d9144392
entries.speaker: _in_memo

entries.text: I try to remember to order a little sooner than that though, because ordering something last minute is pretty uncool.
entries.label: 28ae7f7b
entries.speaker: _in_memo

entries.text: Before we finish, do you have anything else you want to say to the players?
entries.label: 1a4f751
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: This song is not about meat. It is about something else. Please remember this.
entries.label: b04683f5
entries.speaker: _in_aqua

entries.text: This song might be about meat, but it's not actually. (I checked)
entries.label: dd6eeadd
entries.speaker: _in_memo

entries.text: (Producer… are you sure you gave me the right script? This feels like it belongs in the comedy section…)
entries.label: d6c9d88c
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Welcome to our interview room! Please introduce yourself to everyone.
entries.label: 5f1cccbe
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Hello! I am seatrus, a composer from Japan.
entries.label: 17f3638
entries.speaker: _in_seatrus

entries.text: I also regularly train myself as a rhythm game player!
entries.label: 59e894a2
entries.speaker: _in_seatrus

entries.text: It's great to meet you all! Could you tell us about your new track, "INN3RFLAME"?
entries.label: 3990bf20
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: The track "INN3RFLAME" that I've submitted this time
entries.label: c333c8f6
entries.speaker: _in_seatrus

entries.text: still carries my signature style, but with a slightly fresher twist.
entries.label: 48d360b
entries.speaker: _in_seatrus

entries.text: I built it around the theme of hidden passion and a burning will to resist,
entries.label: ae4578c0
entries.speaker: _in_seatrus

entries.text: giving it an energetic mood that's still calm and deeply moving.
entries.label: fd5a4348
entries.speaker: _in_seatrus

entries.text: It features the kind of fast tempo you'd expect from a music game, combined with Hitech‑style bass,
entries.label: 17ca25b0
entries.speaker: _in_seatrus

entries.text: resulting in a track that's both groovy and full of power.
entries.label: 9100f62b
entries.speaker: _in_seatrus

entries.text: On top of that, to match Rotaeno's uniquely immersive gameplay,
entries.label: 215988f6
entries.speaker: _in_seatrus

entries.text: I paid very close attention to the rhythm and overall structure of the track.
entries.label: 470e8e5d
entries.speaker: _in_seatrus

entries.text: So you really put that much thought into crafting this song!
entries.label: c6847680
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I'm sure both the track and its chart will be loved by many players!
entries.label: 2d9e3390
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: In that case, do you have any other messages for the players?
entries.label: 2419b5c
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Thank you all so much for your support!
entries.label: a4cb82d
entries.speaker: _in_seatrus

entries.text: I hope you'll enjoy discovering a new side of seatrus,
entries.label: c3551788
entries.speaker: _in_seatrus

entries.text: different from the songs I've already released in Rotaeno!
entries.label: 6336866e
entries.speaker: _in_seatrus

entries.text: I'll also be challenging myself to clear this track, too :)
entries.speaker: _in_seatrus

entries.text: Hello everyone, I'm Cansol, a composer from South Korea!
entries.label: bf709cd3
entries.speaker: _in_cansol

entries.text: I've been working hard to create songs that are fun and emotionally touching.
entries.label: c561aeb9
entries.speaker: _in_cansol

entries.text: Whether it's your first time meeting me or you already know me, welcome, everyone!
entries.label: a1ec5d90
entries.speaker: _in_cansol

entries.text: Could you introduce your new song "Innocence Keeper" in detail?
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: "Innocence Keeper" is a Future Core track that tells the story of protecting a world of innocence and purity from external threats.
entries.label: 19cee672
entries.speaker: _in_cansol

entries.text: The song combines beautiful and delicate sounds with intense and stimulating elements.
entries.label: 3a46f4dd
entries.speaker: _in_cansol

entries.text: So this song describes such a story!
entries.label: 7bf11ced
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: What were your thoughts when arranging this piece?
entries.label: be591166
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: While composing, I wanted listeners to visualize the story I just described as they listened to the song.
entries.label: 67945d84
entries.speaker: _in_cansol

entries.text: I tried to juxtapose opposing sounds and naturally merge them in music while striving for the clarity of a pure world. This process involved lots of trial and error!
entries.label: 81f9cfc4
entries.speaker: _in_cansol

entries.text: It sounds like an interesting challenge!
entries.label: 4e34a979
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Can you share what makes this song special to you?
entries.label: e8bb9012
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Among various composition techniques, I particularly enjoy reintroducing specific sections with variations later in the track.
entries.label: d73e3156
entries.speaker: _in_cansol

entries.text: In this song, you can pay attention to how the Intro melody and the Drop section change when they reappear in the latter part, which I believe makes the listening experience more enjoyable.
entries.label: f8795bf2
entries.speaker: _in_cansol

entries.text: Also, I have a secret weapon(?)—did anyone notice there's a "rotating" sound in the song?
entries.label: 318ffbcc
entries.speaker: _in_cansol

entries.text: I specifically emphasized this to the Rotaeno team. I wonder if they captured it in the chart :)
entries.label: 1d6e7f06
entries.speaker: _in_cansol

entries.text: Wow~ There really is a "spinning" sound effect in the music!
entries.label: 65ff31ce
entries.speaker: _in_jiang

entries.text: The chart also includes lots of rotate notes and cool effects in the spinning parts. Let's spin it up!! (>w<)
entries.label: e341d3d0
entries.speaker: _in_jiang

entries.text: It seems like this chart will be super fun!
entries.label: 1a90d52a
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Finally, is there anything you'd like to say to the players?
entries.label: 60e6ee3c
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I've been a rhythm game player for a long time and will continue to be one in the future.
entries.label: 43a60688
entries.speaker: _in_cansol

entries.text: Perhaps my journey as a composer started because of my deep love for rhythm games. Before I realized it, my songs were being featured in games!
entries.label: 4393b827
entries.speaker: _in_cansol

entries.text: Thank you all for your unwavering love for rhythm games.
entries.label: f9ca5ad7
entries.speaker: _in_cansol

entries.text: As this is also a field I adore, I will continue working hard and hope to leave you with wonderful memories.
entries.label: 7a7a8a24
entries.speaker: _in_cansol

entries.text: To those of you meeting me for the first time,
entries.label: d9c34497
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: and to those who already know me, I hope for your continued support!
entries.label: 1155302e
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: Your new song has been selected as the winning track. Congratulations! Could you tell us about "悔_"?
entries.label: 107c6c60
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I wrote this track not long after I started using vocal synthesis software.
entries.label: c58321ae
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: Around that time, I had also just begun writing vocal songs in general.
entries.label: b5f087cd
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: That's why I remember the whole process of creating the vocals being quite a challenge.
entries.label: 6232433e
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: The hardest part for me was definitely writing the lyrics.
entries.label: d93f4066
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: Especially since Japanese isn't my native language,
entries.label: 8a8ebb96
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: it was quite difficult to fully express what I wanted to say through the lyrics.
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: I personally think Artcore is a perfect match for abstract, dreamlike lyrics like these.
entries.label: 74de7fa
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: And of course, this style also fits rhythm games really well!
entries.label: 13a3b723
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: I've always loved music that feels both mysterious and intense,
entries.label: fac5bcde
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: so I arranged this track to capture exactly that kind of vibe.
entries.label: 2ee096e5
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: Your very first vocal track is in a non‑native language…!
entries.label: c1dcf038
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: That's such a bold and cool decision!
entries.label: bf87ba96
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Speaking of the lyrics, could you tell us more about them?
entries.label: 8e15fd34
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Even if you feel regret, don't let it trap or define you.
entries.label: 348df240
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: Instead, you should still have the courage to move forward.
entries.label: e1ebd8a5
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: It might sound like a pretty ordinary piece of advice.
entries.label: efeefe3b
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: But when something "simple" like this actually happens in real life,
entries.label: f94012a8
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: it isn't always easy to put into practice. I've been through that myself lol.
entries.label: ffdea8d8
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: If you could think of these lyrics as
entries.label: 1c2ff0
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: "a little slice of my real‑life experiences", I'd really appreciate it.
entries.label: b8ed10a6
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: It really sounds like you've gone through a lot in life, Essbee…
entries.label: 5a83adff
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Lastly, is there any special message or hope you'd like to share with Rotaeno players?
entries.label: 20cae894
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Thank you so much to everyone who has listened to and played my song,
entries.label: 582d69ce
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: and also to the Rotaeno team for giving me this incredible opportunity!
entries.label: d7f9c709
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: From now on, how you feel about and interpret this track is entirely up to you.
entries.label: 617196ad
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: If it sparks any feelings or vivid images in your mind while you listen,
entries.label: e45a2c7b
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: That would make me really happy as a composer.
entries.label: f63deef8
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: I'm planning to write many more tracks in different styles from now on. Thank you very much for your support!!
entries.label: eeb42fba
entries.speaker: _in_essbee

entries.text: Could you please introduce yourself to our audience?
entries.label: cd87fd53
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I'm INuya, and I mostly compose cute music >o<
entries.label: 7d78a254
entries.speaker: _in_inuya

entries.text: Could you tell us more about your new song, "Love Splash"?
entries.label: 4eca7026
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: "Love Splash" is an electro-house track with a cute vocal.
entries.label: a728fdd6
entries.speaker: _in_inuya

entries.text: The lyrics describe the feelings of a girl who doesn't know what to do in front of someone she likes.
entries.label: e5ac0c0
entries.speaker: _in_inuya

entries.text: I thought it would be fun to express her heart, which feels like it's about to burst, with the word "Splash," so that's how the title "Love Splash" came about.
entries.label: aed12e58
entries.speaker: _in_inuya

entries.text: Oh, so that's what the title means!
entries.label: 1c5b0083
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: What was your approach to the composition?
entries.label: be591166
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I wanted to create a song where you can enjoy multiple layers of fun from start to finish.
entries.label: 266137b
entries.speaker: _in_inuya

entries.text: By paying attention to the placement of various sounds and instruments, I believe listeners can find even more things to enjoy.
entries.label: 2dc4fc11
entries.speaker: _in_inuya

entries.text: This song really sounds so interesting!
entries.label: d8e2b496
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Could you share what makes this song special to you?
entries.label: e8bb9012
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: From start to finish, the song is filled with sounds that I personally love—like the glitchy piano and bass that cut off abruptly, the thick synthesizer tones, and the complex bass lines of Complextro... It's just amazing!
entries.label: 6e05aa1d
entries.speaker: _in_inuya

entries.text: Lastly, do you have any message for the players?
entries.label: 60e6ee3c
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I hope everyone likes this song as much as I do.
entries.label: 571d314a
entries.speaker: _in_inuya

entries.text: Please play it a lot, and I'll keep working hard to create even cooler and cuter music... Splash!
entries.label: 7569fc07
entries.speaker: _in_inuya

entries.text: Welcome to our interview room~! First of all, could you introduce yourself?
entries.label: fbe7e0e1
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Hello, Rotaeno players, nice to meet you, I'm kuro!!!!
entries.label: 2f68d12d
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: I write all kinds of tracks—from rhythm‑game style songs
entries.label: 5bab46f6
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: to songs that are completely outside that style.
entries.label: da765460
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: It's a pleasure to meet you all~!
entries.label: d8b36fd7
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Could you tell us a bit about your new piece, "ミルキーウェイを辿って"?
entries.label: d8be39cc
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: With "ミルキーウェイを辿って",
entries.label: 77d8d784
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: I started from the Artcore sound I usually work with,
entries.label: 86af1b2e
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: then mixed in brighter elements from genres like HAPPY HARDCORE and Future Bass,
entries.label: 999462ec
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: and experimented with all kinds of rhythmic patterns,
entries.label: 5a710e7c
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: so I arranged the track to feel even more lively and dynamic than my usual work,
entries.label: d600799f
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: hoping this will bring a richer listening experience.
entries.label: beb318e8
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: I tried to strike a balance between making it fun to play as a rhythm‑game chart
entries.label: 44dc01b7
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: and enjoyable to listen to simply as a piece of music.
entries.label: ab63beb8
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: I'll be really happy if you are enjoying!
entries.label: 699b9b59
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: When I listened to it, it felt like Lulua was being drawn deep into the vast galaxy.
entries.label: 63bf396a
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Was that the main source of inspiration for this song?
entries.label: e18b90a8
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Actually, just as the title suggests,
entries.label: 3a3295b7
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: I pictured a journey toward the very edge of the galaxy,
entries.label: 859ca2d5
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: wondering, "If I follow this trail of sparkling light, what will I find at the end!?"
entries.label: 725662c1
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: Driven by that sense of curiosity,
entries.label: 323209cf
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: it feels like you're soaring through outer space, across distances of light‑years!
entries.label: 3db5210
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: That's awesome! Now then, do you have any special message for Rotaeno players?
entries.label: 68b3117e
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Thank you so much for giving me this opportunity.
entries.label: 140c2349
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: I've contributed a few tracks before,
entries.label: c71484de
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: but this is the first time I've written a song specifically for Rotaeno,
entries.label: c2c3c99c
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: so it feels really special to me.
entries.label: c04ea5f7
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: To all you Pilots out there, I hope you'll imagine that kind of scene
entries.label: 1ad3457f
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: and dive into the game on your devices as enthusiastically as you can!!!!
entries.label: 5ce83fdc
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: I'll be playing it like crazy too!
entries.label: b9e46ef0
entries.speaker: _in_kuro

entries.text: Welcome to our interview! Could you please introduce yourself for us?
entries.label: 77e0a16
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I'm Se-U-Ra. I like creating all sorts of things.
entries.label: e445ab3e
entries.speaker: _in_seura

entries.text: I tend to move a lot after eating sushi.
entries.label: 258955a
entries.speaker: _in_seura

entries.text: Haha, your love for food is really strong…
entries.label: ad74a55e
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Could you make an introduction to your new song "六天照來"  here?
entries.label: be9c2c8b
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I remember the song being inspired by a bright, mischievous Amaterasu-like character.
entries.label: 6a316975
entries.speaker: _in_seura

entries.text: It's a bouncy track with distinctive triplets.
entries.label: 95c66485
entries.speaker: _in_seura

entries.text: I had sushi after finishing it.
entries.label: 4d674947
entries.speaker: _in_seura

entries.text: …Wow, this song feels just as energetic as you…!
entries.label: 4b1d164e
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: So, is there anything you'd like to say to the players?
entries.label: ed181095
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: …(Last time it was steak… and this time it's sushi…)
entries.label: ede13c4e
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Please start by introducing yourself to everyone!
entries.label: f13d569
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I am U-ske, a Japanese composer.
entries.label: e478f1ef
entries.speaker: _in_uske

entries.text: Could you please share more details with us about your new track"NINJA-ish"?
entries.label: b934de11
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I think Japanese-style music is somewhat exotic, but I wanted to add a pop, kawaii element to it.
entries.label: 7d7c3d5c
entries.speaker: _in_uske

entries.text: So I asked Nanahira-san to do the vocals for kawaii ninja.
entries.label: 2baa3dc
entries.speaker: _in_uske

entries.text: Ninjas usually hide in the shadows and show their strength in important situations.
entries.speaker: _in_uske

entries.text: That's just how people imagine ninjas!
entries.label: c9a2a22d
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: This song has the message, "It's okay to be unmotivated in everyday life, but when it comes to important situations, you have to be serious!"
entries.label: 3efcbf7d
entries.speaker: _in_uske

entries.text: As we come to the end of the interview, is there anything you'd like to say to the players?
entries.label: d76d35d5
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I said that ninjas usually hide in the shadows.
entries.label: 5c275f0
entries.speaker: _in_uske

entries.text: In other words, its existence must not be known.
entries.label: b8b43ad0
entries.speaker: _in_uske

entries.text: Now that I've made it public, I may never be able to appear in public again...
entries.label: f7e19df3
entries.speaker: _in_uske

entries.text: Huh? Did Mr. U-ske just disappear all of a sudden?!
entries.label: a0e8e369
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: First, could you please introduce yourself to our audience?
entries.label: cd87fd53
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I mainly compose music in rhythm game styles.
entries.label: e2cad983
entries.speaker: _in_lucapro

entries.text: Could you tell us more about your new song, "Quadruplicity"?
entries.label: 58b3063b
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: This track is my first piece combining world music and electronic music styles.
entries.label: acff00ec
entries.speaker: _in_lucapro

entries.text: It's also my first collaboration project and marks the starting point of my current creative style, making it very meaningful to me.
entries.label: 5f012f59
entries.speaker: _in_lucapro

entries.text: Combining these two distinct styles is an interesting attempt!
entries.label: d331bbbd
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I heard there was a special collaboration during the creative process?
entries.label: 1878d7eb
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: After I roughly finished the track, NeLiME listened to it and liked it so much that they contributed a lot of additional arrangements.
entries.label: f18a357a
entries.speaker: _in_lucapro

entries.text: For example, adding instruments like electric guitar, adjusting the Drop sections, and handling the mixing and mastering, which ultimately completed the song.
entries.label: 334cbac2
entries.speaker: _in_lucapro

entries.text: I think the perfect blend of world music and electronic music is the biggest highlight of this track.
entries.speaker: _in_lucapro

entries.text: I'm sure players will be thrilled to see your collaboration!
entries.label: 4e16e2bb
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Lastly, do you have anything you'd like to say to the players?
entries.label: 60e6ee3c
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I've been eager to share this song with everyone, and I'm honored to meet you all through Rotaeno.
entries.label: 94cf3a95
entries.speaker: _in_lucapro

entries.text: I hope you enjoy this song!
entries.label: 2167b955
entries.speaker: _in_lucapro

entries.text: I will continue to create great music to share with everyone in the future!
entries.label: 51d36658
entries.speaker: _in_lucapro

entries.text: First, could you please introduce yourself?
entries.label: cd87fd53
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I absolutely love rhythm games and music!
entries.label: 42753d1c
entries.speaker: _in_minnie

entries.text: Inspired by the atmosphere where people freely share music in the world of rhythm games, I started composing music, and it's been seven years now!
entries.speaker: _in_minnie

entries.text: I'm so happy to have the chance to release my work in Rotaeno this time!
entries.label: 417b2066
entries.speaker: _in_minnie

entries.text: Could you tell us more about your new song, "Secret Planet"?
entries.label: 6e4b9304
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: The theme of "Secret Planet" is "continuous challenges" and "making dreams a reality"!
entries.label: 775b1f4
entries.speaker: _in_minnie

entries.text: I imagine the Rotaeno team must have faced many challenges to achieve their unique world and system!
entries.label: 21eba215
entries.speaker: _in_minnie

entries.text: This song carries my support for the Rotaeno development team and my wishes for Rotaeno's future growth!
entries.label: 565a0546
entries.speaker: _in_minnie

entries.text: Of course, the song also includes imagery of Ilot's cosmic journey!
entries.label: b3e1682f
entries.speaker: _in_minnie

entries.text: Thank you so much for your support!
entries.label: d03e4b49
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Lastly, do you have any message for the players?
entries.label: 60e6ee3c
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: As a Rotaeno player, I'm as excited as everyone else about Ilot's journey!
entries.label: 40855ae8
entries.speaker: _in_minnie

entries.text: Let's continue to enjoy the world of Rotaeno together!
entries.label: 59086c07
entries.speaker: _in_minnie

entries.text: Hello! I'm Nanchou, a new composer from Xinjiang, China.
entries.label: 550852be
entries.speaker: _in_nanchou

entries.text: Hi~! Could you tell us about your work, "伊天珀凌"?
entries.label: 8de5f340
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: When I was working on "伊天珀凌",
entries.label: 12a45081
entries.speaker: _in_nanchou

entries.text: all kinds of images kept popping into my mind.
entries.label: 5c196f4a
entries.speaker: _in_nanchou

entries.text: Maybe it's because I really love Ilot and Hoppe,
entries.label: 3a02f9d4
entries.speaker: _in_nanchou

entries.text: so I picked one Chinese character from each of their names to form the song's title.
entries.label: e7a58ba7
entries.speaker: _in_nanchou

entries.text: Oh, so there's a hidden suprise in the title!
entries.label: 1d31c6a6
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: For this track, I really focused on the melody and on bringing out my own signature sound,
entries.label: 5e254c1d
entries.speaker: _in_nanchou

entries.text: and I didn't lock myself into any single genre.
entries.label: 1c24ad3f
entries.speaker: _in_nanchou

entries.text: In each section, I combined different elements.
entries.label: fc6c9633
entries.speaker: _in_nanchou

entries.text: I think the result is a fun track that stays engaging and doesn't get boring to listen to.
entries.label: 20e02472
entries.speaker: _in_nanchou

entries.text: What really makes this song stand out is the sense of "speed" you feel at your fingertips while playing it.
entries.label: db67a505
entries.speaker: _in_nanchou

entries.text: Sometimes the drum beats and melody run side by side, and sometimes they switch roles,
entries.label: 71e7224f
entries.speaker: _in_nanchou

entries.text: and I wanted to create a fresh play experience that feels like you're "rotating" as you play.
entries.label: c256cea
entries.speaker: _in_nanchou

entries.text: With the sound effects I added at key moments,
entries.label: f1e3c659
entries.speaker: _in_nanchou

entries.text: I hope every note you hit will feel like a ripple spreading across the surface of water.
entries.label: 616209d0
entries.speaker: _in_nanchou

entries.text: Thank you so much for creating such an exciting track!
entries.label: c1fb2700
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Lastly, do you have any message for the players?
entries.label: fb9ae939
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: First of all, I'm truly grateful to the Rotaeno team for giving me this opportunity.
entries.label: f0215f69
entries.speaker: _in_nanchou

entries.text: I'd also like to give big thanks to everyone who helped with the charts and illustrations.
entries.label: 518d13f0
entries.speaker: _in_nanchou

entries.text: My best friend Arkito has also given me so much support,
entries.label: 63af9359
entries.speaker: _in_nanchou

entries.text: and my family and close friends are always cheering me on as well.
entries.label: a862fe67
entries.speaker: _in_nanchou

entries.text: Thanks to all of them, I've been able to keep going and make it this far.
entries.speaker: _in_nanchou

entries.text: This is the first time I've truly been able to appear in a rhythm game, and it's incredibly moving for me.
entries.label: 33a64ef4
entries.speaker: _in_nanchou

entries.text: I'd be so happy if you could enjoy this song too. I hope you all have a wonderful day!
entries.label: 5851a5b1
entries.speaker: _in_nanchou

entries.text: Welcome to our interview, both of you!
entries.label: 1032882f
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: First, could you please introduce yourselves?
entries.label: cd87fd53
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I love music that evokes stories and landscapes, and I'm a freelance composer.
entries.label: 73eb8edc
entries.speaker: _in_aaaa

entries.text: I can create any type of music.
entries.label: dde23d95
entries.speaker: _in_aaaa

entries.text: Whether it's bright music or dark music, I enjoy all styles—I'm a versatile composer!
entries.label: 50a7d826
entries.speaker: _in_dada

entries.text: It's great to meet you both!
entries.label: 338965c
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Could you tell us more about your new song "Starlight Traveler" and your thoughts on working together?
entries.label: 38226a1c
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Since 打打だいず-kun is a creator I've admired for a long time, I took this collaboration very seriously.
entries.label: 13dfc03
entries.speaker: _in_aaaa

entries.text: During the production process, I focused on the unique features of rhythm games while doing my best to maximize 打打だいず-kun's talents.
entries.label: 7abcc49a
entries.speaker: _in_aaaa

entries.text: The production process was truly enjoyable.
entries.label: 3e158b9
entries.speaker: _in_aaaa

entries.text: I was responsible for the overall composition and part of the arrangement, while 打打だいず-kun handled most of the arrangement.
entries.label: 63395f9c
entries.speaker: _in_aaaa

entries.text: This is the first time I've collaborated with ああああ-sensei, whom I deeply respect!
entries.label: 8b9e8c1b
entries.speaker: _in_dada

entries.text: We combined our favorite elements without holding back, and I believe we created an amazing track!
entries.label: 54c08b1a
entries.speaker: _in_dada

entries.text: You can really feel a sense of joy in this new song!
entries.label: c254f0fc
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I'm sure it will provide players with an exciting experience.
entries.label: de44154e
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Lastly, do you have any messages for the players?
entries.label: ebe1eab7
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Please enjoy this high-speed journey through the galaxy to the fullest!
entries.label: b12b5c73
entries.speaker: _in_aaaa

entries.text: We wish you a pleasant journey!
entries.label: 85932a46
entries.speaker: _in_dada

entries.text: Please start by introducing yourself to everyone!
entries.label: 501888ff
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Hi I'm Violet Delta, and I'm a newcomer rhythm game composer from Malaysia.
entries.label: cb73ea6b
entries.speaker: _in_violetd

entries.text: I can't believe you're a newbie!
entries.label: 3ea96655
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Could you please share something with us about your new track"Starstream Sky Dash"?
entries.label: c4580265
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Thank you so much to the Rotaeno team for providing me this opportunity.
entries.label: 1d827008
entries.speaker: _in_violetd

entries.text: During the contest, I asked myself
entries.label: 6f51b844
entries.speaker: _in_violetd

entries.text: what if I made a song that feels like riding a spaceship at high-hypersonic speeds through the cosmos,
entries.label: bee7fa02
entries.speaker: _in_violetd

entries.text: and I tried to incorporate said experience into my song.
entries.label: 9fcac98f
entries.speaker: _in_violetd

entries.text: That's how "Starstream Sky Dash" was born.
entries.label: 188839d
entries.speaker: _in_violetd

entries.text: It is also my first time making and combining two genres that are quite different from each other, namely techcore and footwork.
entries.label: de1e6c10
entries.speaker: _in_violetd

entries.text: Thanks for bringing this creative work to Rotaeno!
entries.label: aba78326
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Do you have any message for the players?
entries.label: b810e6b9
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: I hope you enjoy my song to the fullest, feel free to share your experience of playing my song on social media if you can.
entries.label: 2f5b13ef
entries.speaker: _in_violetd

entries.text: First, could you introduce yourself to everyone?
entries.label: cd87fd53
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Although I'm still a total beginner in composing for rhythm games, I'll keep working hard.
entries.label: f1bb66c6
entries.speaker: _in_shiba

entries.text: It's a pleasure to meet you!
entries.label: b3c952b1
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Could you tell us more about your new song, "Toys' Nightlife Area"?
entries.label: 3b7c05e5
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: This song was one of the first works I created when I started composing on a computer, so it holds a lot of meaning for me (though now, listening to it, I feel more embarrassed about my lack of skill at the time than nostalgic…).
entries.label: 8f63c69a
entries.speaker: _in_shiba

entries.text: I was both thrilled and surprised that Rotaeno included this song.
entries.label: 711e9976
entries.speaker: _in_shiba

entries.text: I'm truly grateful to them for giving me this opportunity.
entries.label: 32e633c9
entries.speaker: _in_shiba

entries.text: We heard that the song has a unique world concept. Could you share more details about that?
entries.label: 98fb752e
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: The song is themed around a cute and magical scene where, after children fall asleep, their toys come to life, singing and dancing to enjoy their time.
entries.label: f65448b5
entries.speaker: _in_shiba

entries.text: I incorporated toy sound effects and added various elements such as cuteness, fantasy, and liveliness to create a detailed expression of this scene. I also aimed to provide players with an adventure that won't feel boring.
entries.label: 1a328596
entries.speaker: _in_shiba

entries.text: It sounds like a fun adventure for the players!
entries.label: 871b534f
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Is there anything special about the rhythm in the song?
entries.label: f3bc05f1
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: The BPM of this song is 111, which is relatively slow for rhythm games.
entries.label: b3496bed
entries.speaker: _in_shiba

entries.text: However, this lower BPM allows the song's details to shine through and enhances the immersion. Even slight rhythm changes have a significant impact, increasing the challenge. I think these elements make rhythm games more interesting.
entries.label: d8ca451
entries.speaker: _in_shiba

entries.text: So, this song was created with a focus on both the "world concept" and the "fun of playing."
entries.label: 99aa2607
entries.speaker: _in_shiba

entries.text: Finally, is there anything you'd like to say to the players?
entries.label: 60e6ee3c
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: First, I want to thank everyone who has listened to this song, the illustrator for the cover art, the chart creators... Thank you all so much!
entries.label: 1a21630a
entries.speaker: _in_shiba

entries.text: If anyone enjoys this song, I'd be delighted…!
entries.label: eacd2a82
entries.speaker: _in_shiba

entries.text: I hope this experience can be a stepping stone for greater achievements in the future. Please support me!
entries.label: f8d03e0f
entries.speaker: _in_shiba

entries.text: (One more time… My name is ShiBa…)
entries.label: b6b86a03
entries.speaker: _in_shiba

entries.text: I hope you can also transform into a toy secretly enjoying yourself at night and immerse yourself in the world of this song!
entries.label: 9f38832e
entries.speaker: _in_shiba

entries.text: First, please introduce yourself to everyone!
entries.label: cd87fd53
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Thank you for your support in the songs "Chrysanthemum" and "Cynthia"!
entries.label: db06e4ca
entries.speaker: _in_7mai

entries.text: Congratulations on having your new song selected as the contested winner!
entries.label: ad6b9168
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Could you tell us more about your newly released song, "Uchronia"?
entries.label: 9edb2c89
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: "Uchronia" means an ideal land that has already been completed, so there are no historical changes or developments, like a world where time has stopped.
entries.label: 367529d1
entries.speaker: _in_7mai

entries.text: In terms of the music, although it starts with a solemn atmosphere, the arrival of a "certain someone" who might disrupt order and balance in a good or bad way causes the halted history to start moving again...
entries.label: f112fc22
entries.speaker: _in_7mai

entries.text: It was created with such an atmosphere in mind.
entries.label: e96da
entries.speaker: _in_7mai

entries.text: Finally, do you have any messages for the players?
entries.label: 60e6ee3c
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: The chart is expected to feature slightly fast 16th-note streams, making it quite a challenging chart.
entries.label: 94a0ee5c
entries.speaker: _in_7mai

entries.text: It's definitely something to look forward to!
entries.label: 868a5008
entries.speaker: _in_7mai

entries.text: Ta-da~! We're back at our interview spot!
entries.label: cea5579b
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: This time, we have the champion—Mr. Mono.☆!
entries.label: 99cd63f
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Every day, I'm piecing together notes, hoping they'll come together as a brilliant story.
entries.label: 13cfa626
entries.speaker: _in_mono

entries.text: Congratulations on your track being picked as the winner!
entries.label: ad6b9168
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Could you tell us a bit about your brilliant work "way home"?
entries.label: 629dfde0
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: This song paints a picture—of days from a past just a little brighter, clearer, and more radiant than the world today.
entries.label: da0b0c32
entries.speaker: _in_mono

entries.text: Days spent gazing out in a daze at my desk,listening to the endless, meaningless drone of lessons, like a chant,
entries.label: aa32dfca
entries.speaker: _in_mono

entries.text: waiting for that final bell to ring, announcing the end of school.
entries.label: 86ae436e
entries.speaker: _in_mono

entries.text: Saying "See you later, catch you in a bit" to my friends, then skipping down the stairs two steps at a time,
entries.label: cc5c6518
entries.speaker: _in_mono

entries.text: racing all the way home on that familiar path back at day's end.
entries.label: 16d79f30
entries.speaker: _in_mono

entries.text: This track is the echo of those days.
entries.label: 3188a462
entries.speaker: _in_mono

entries.text: Those days now feel almost imaginary, as if they only ever existed in a dream—but back then, it truly felt like that time might go on forever.
entries.label: d428c714
entries.speaker: _in_mono

entries.text: I wanted to share with you the warmth, the softness, the racing heartbeat—those fleeting moments shaped by sound.
entries.label: 80b6d880
entries.speaker: _in_mono

entries.text: If you close your eyes, can you remember it too—the endless crimson sky, drenched in the glow of sunset?
entries.label: 8c651d0c
entries.speaker: _in_mono

entries.text: Wow… Mr. Mono., you're really a great storyteller!
entries.label: f50268e1
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: That just brought back my own fond memories of school days, too! >q<
entries.label: e11bb368
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Before we wrap up, do you have any messages you'd like to share with the players?
entries.label: c4b86100
entries.speaker: lulua

entries.text: Thank you so much for reading this far…
entries.label: 4ca9bdd2
entries.speaker: _in_mono

entries.text: That must mean you're interested in this piece of music, right?
entries.label: 9e4599b0
entries.speaker: _in_mono

entries.text: As I mentioned earlier, there's an important story woven into this track—But the story goes far beyond just the music itself!
entries.label: a45e99f
entries.speaker: _in_mono

entries.text: Writing the song had its own story, and so did the moment it was picked for the competition.
entries.label: 990dd704
entries.speaker: _in_mono

entries.text: The artist painting the cover art, the charter creating the note patterns—even the song's final arrival in Rotaeno,
entries.label: 1a805571
entries.speaker: _in_mono

entries.text: —each step has its own unique story to tell.
entries.label: 46eec223
entries.speaker: _in_mono

entries.text: And of course, Rotaeno itself is the product of so many stories coming together.
entries.label: 70db6d48
entries.speaker: _in_mono

entries.text: Every scene in it is alive with so many different stories.
entries.label: 2b6a47c7
entries.speaker: _in_mono

entries.text: In this age where everything seems to be quickly consumed—whether it's a game, a piece of music, an illustration, or any other creation—each and every one of them is alive, breathing with its own story!
entries.label: 85a58b8e
entries.speaker: _in_mono

entries.text: ROLLING SLIME MAGAZINE 32nd ISSUE – RISING ROCKSTARS
entries.label: 4b5c0cb1

entries.text: SPECIAL EDITION INTERVIEW WITH SLIMY VAN SHALEN
entries.label: 4b5c0cb1

entries.text: With the girl group "The Sweethearts" upcoming New Year's Eve concert, many fans have been very curious about the revelation of the opening act artist – Slimy Van Shalen.
entries.label: 6719dafe

entries.text: First off, it's an honor to be doing this interview with you. Thank you for taking the time to join us.
entries.label: 853a848

entries.text: How do you describe yourself as an artist?
entries.label: 853a848

entries.text: The pleasure is mine! I would call myself a virtuosic musician with an exploratory approach to music production.
entries.label: 7ab7cfd7

entries.text: My musical talent is a force of nature – my melodies could end political stalemate and even alter the weather!
entries.label: 773a9b6c

entries.text: What can I say? My skills are so vast that it's currently under review by several scientific journals.
entries.label: 11306fdd

entries.text: They say I play music with the raw power of a young Beethoven, but with better hair for sure~
entries.label: 11306fdd

entries.text: Heck, even my instruments have their own fan club!
entries.label: 11306fdd

entries.text: Well, where do you get your musical inspiration?
entries.label: 9826b885

entries.text: Truth be told, my daughter is my greatest source of motivation!
entries.label: 3d211880

entries.text: Because of her, I am encouraged to be dedicated to all of my work, and so, her existence pushes me forward.
entries.label: d9eba397

entries.text: Before, I had goals. Now, my ambitions are measured by her happiness!
entries.label: d9eba397

entries.text: She is the most adorable girl in the universe!
entries.label: 96152f60

entries.text: One time, she drew a picture of me on stage, can you believe it?
entries.label: c1a2832d

entries.text: Her masterpiece, this beautiful drawing of my majestic performance pose,
entries.label: 709a92b7

entries.text: will probably end up in Slimesonian Museum one day, and future generations can marvel at it, I just know it!
entries.label: 709a92b7

entries.text: She does get her brilliance from me, so it's only natural that I get inspired by her!
entries.label: 8f03be63

entries.text: Sounds like you are a doting father... How do you avoid burnout as a musician?
entries.label: 6a7bae85

entries.text: Yes, yes! She is the cutest!
entries.label: 7c914dd4

entries.text: Every time she hugs me, I think, "This is it. This is the moment I finally melt into a puddle~"
entries.label: 7c914dd4

entries.text: Now, ways to avoid burnout, huh? Tricky!
entries.label: d24bf2bb

entries.text: Count yourself lucky that I will share with you some of my top secrets. You gotta cultivate a great work-life balance by having hobbies outside of music and set boundaries to avoid over-commitment.
entries.label: 3a4df885

entries.text: I also mix up my routine to stay fresh and prevent monotony.
entries.label: 374f2b22

entries.text: You know, my wife is always very proud that I keep the best moisture levels among our people, because I keep myself saturated with various projects!
entries.label: 87ceec5e

entries.text: Most importantly, staying properly hydrated is crucial for mental clarity and overall performance~
entries.label: 7b038148

entries.text: What advice would you give to other young aspiring musicians?
entries.label: 5b5ce6e0

entries.text: Always B sharp and never B flat with your ambitions!
entries.label: a03a23e6

entries.text: Haha! Jokes aside, don't be a musical monoculture!
entries.label: 4b77878c

entries.text: A little genre-bending is good for the soul.
entries.label: 4b77878c

entries.text: It's fine if you don't like a new song, just give it a chance.
entries.label: aada61fe

entries.text: Maybe it'll resonate with you or lead you on an adventure you never expected!
entries.label: aada61fe

entries.text: Nevertheless, I am the best example that you should learn from, so you'd better follow all my artist social media accounts!
entries.label: da05cd52

entries.text: By the way, my advice is worth more than gold,
entries.label: 24c1f420

entries.text: though I will kindly accept nice big cartons of fresh organic coconut juice in return~
entries.label: 24c1f420

entries.text: "With this much snowfall overnight, it's the perfect time to go snow sledding! We need to find a hill that has a long, open run.
entries.label: 7eea926a

entries.text: It's got to be steep enough for speed, but not dangerously so, and free of obstacles like rocks and bushes!"
entries.label: 7eea926a

entries.text: "Through the many years of my foraging adventures deep into the forest, I know a perfect place up above the eastern trail, similar to what you described."
entries.label: e881c0ce

entries.text: "Snow sledding, Boss? But can we really afford to waste precious practice time? I was thinking about practicing the latest stunt that you taught me..."
entries.label: 1496b383

entries.text: "Well, I had heard that diversification of athletic training is imperative for developing competency and preventing overuse injuries."
entries.label: 31903d4e

entries.text: "Hey, elf-boy...C-could you speak in simpler language, please?"
entries.label: 28687fa2

entries.text: "It's really not that hard, kiddo. You should really brush up on your vocabulary."
entries.label: bb075237

entries.text: "Actually, he's right. What he really means is that cross-training will help us work all our muscles, so we don't wear out the same body parts and train new skills at the same time. Resting from practice is just another weapon in our arsenal!"
entries.label: 9bf0d6f8

entries.text: "Wow, Boss, you are as wise as ever! I see that you had a grand plan all along! No wonder you had already prepared these sleds ahead of time. How could we get the permit into the forest, though?"
entries.label: f5f932b7

entries.text: "I could petition with Grandpa Angatu to let you both into the Elf forest. Since I have to vouch for your entry, I trust you all will be on your best behavior?"
entries.label: 5120bbeb

entries.text: "Ooh, definitely! And we'll be sure to thank him if he allows it! Is there anything we should do in return?"
entries.label: a5bc8e77

entries.text: "Truthfully, I have been intrigued by your human training regime, so I want you to locate the best vantage point for me to observe your training."
entries.label: dcdf0fbe

entries.text: "Now, now, you must join us in the fun too! After you get the elder's permission, won't you please lead us to that hill you mentioned? I will share with you my best sledding tricks!"
entries.label: 36333e34

entries.text: "...Hmm. Since you put it that way, I will take you up on your offer. Stand by here and wait for my instructions upon my return."
entries.label: f0c6010a

entries.text: "Oh, there he goes into the forest...Aww, can't he just be honest for once, that he is actually excited too, eh?
entries.label: 1e38db16

entries.text: Count me in, Boss! I will try to ace this cross-training thing too!"
entries.label: 1e38db16

entries.text: "You bet! Let's make this break time count towards our next performance!"
entries.label: e2f13de8

entries.text: On one of Master Orlan's online meet-and-greet sessions, Ilot's favorite idol talked about his recent experience eating a very delicious caramelized upside-down apple cake.
entries.label: 9e22ff85

entries.text: Ilot begged Hoppe to bake it for her so that she could understand the hype.
entries.label: a2b1e185

entries.text: True to her academic nature, Hoppe was always very technical with cooking, meticulously going through multiple recipes by researching in the library,
entries.label: 838917d9

entries.text: even going as far as analyzing varieties of apples and their suitability for baking, before finalizing on the cooking steps.
entries.label: a21a7575

entries.text: One day, the studious girl finally invited Ilot to the cooking classroom to attempt baking the apple cake.
In between ingredient prepping and making the cake batter, Hoppe had voiced out her observations on some chemical concepts of what makes the cake delicious.
entries.label: cd12f8b2

entries.text: She explained how both the Maillard reaction and caramelization create complex flavors, such as smoky and nutty notes in foods that are cooked to a dark brown color.
entries.label: bffe7751

entries.text: She also suspected that they might encounter some challenges ahead, but mishaps could be prevented if they strictly followed the recipe.
entries.label: fd2f333

entries.text: While washing the cooking utensils, Ilot lamented that it had not snowed in Aquaria this year, even though it was deep into the winter season.
entries.label: 3c805c43

entries.text: She reminisced on the precious memories of them as little kids, building snowmen and making snow angels in the freshly snow-covered field near their homes.
entries.label: 6d1daa58

entries.text: Hoppe visibly turned pensive as she realized that they did not have much time left together until she departs from Aquaria.
entries.label: 274ec6ae

entries.text: Although she was determined to further research the cause of the Endless Rain, she was also saddened by the impending separation.
They were both lost in their thoughts when the baking was completed.
entries.label: d9ec98a8

entries.text: The recipe called for letting the cake rest out of the oven for 15 minutes before it was overturned, exposing the browned slices of apples that were previously arranged on the bottom of the cake pan.
entries.label: 22b85700

entries.text: Being a stickler for accuracy, Hoppe was completely absorbed in an almost destructive obsession, stressing endlessly over whether the cake was perfectly caramelized or utterly burnt.
entries.label: 8c1ebd31

entries.text: Noticing her growing anxiety, Ilot grabbed a piece of circular parchment paper on the spur of the moment and folded it quickly.
entries.label: 5a2f4e41

entries.text: After a series of cuts and trimmings using a pair of kitchen scissors, she unfolded an angel-shaped piece, which she then placed at the center of the cooled-down apple cake.
entries.label: 5c368e6d

entries.text: Hoppe frowned in confusion as her childhood friend motioned to her to hold a fine mesh sieve strainer above the cake.The blue-haired girl gleefully disappeared into the side pantry before returning with a mysterious bag of white powder.
entries.label: 91b05cb7

entries.text: er eyes twinkled as she scooped a handful of powder into the strainer, "Hoppe, what if we let it snow here now?"
entries.label: 996b5d66

entries.text: Hoppe's eyes widened as Ilot gently tapped the strainer to sift the powder. A fine, ethereal snowfall of powdered sugar dusted the entire surface of the cake.
entries.label: c3820153

entries.text: They gently lifted the angel-shaped parchment paper off the cake surface, revealing a clean snow angel underneath, surrounded by a soft, fresh dusting of snow.
entries.label: bd485202

entries.text: As the two girls shared a silent moment of wonder, a mischievous glance was all it took before they both giggled away.
entries.label: 3d88d4e3

entries.text: As always, Ilot's empathy and spontaneous spirit had a way of anchoring Hoppe in the present, like a grounding cord for her overthinking mind.
entries.label: 53fa85d

entries.text: For the rest of the evening, they merrily enjoyed the sumptuous upside-down apple cake, accompanied by hot cocoa and black tea.
entries.label: 21b84f4b

entries.text: My love deserves all the best that I could offer her.
entries.label: eb732ca8

entries.text: I knew I had to surprise her with an overnight trip in Sahith Desert for our wedding anniversary this year.
entries.label: 33d50cbd

entries.text: That was the fated place where we met after all.
entries.label: 6f3dbed

entries.text: She loved the enchanting stars that glitter through the midnight sky of this desert planet.
entries.label: 49c06c37

entries.text: Then again, even in a galaxy full of stars, she is the only one who truly shines for me.
When I felt so lost that fateful day, she was the brightest star that guided me to safety.
entries.label: fbb514a1

entries.text: For many months, I had to go through so much to arrange a one-night stay with one of our acquaintances from the Association of Orb Innkeepers.
entries.label: c34fa41a

entries.text: I was very sure Kakari would love this romantic stargazing getaway at the geodesic dome tent, right in the middle of the beautiful desert.
entries.label: 4bc7727b

entries.text: Naturally, she was beyond thrilled when we arrived at the dome. The structure of the unique tent was breathtaking, to say the least.
entries.label: d2686b3a

entries.text: As she explored the inner layout, she was almost incoherent with joy, repeatedly praising me for my efforts.
entries.label: d2686b3a

entries.text: Her genuine reaction still warms my heart to this day.
entries.label: 665c9302

entries.text: Little did I know that the skies would turn against me.
entries.label: 5cbf9835

entries.text: The suspiciously gloomy clouds that had threatened the horizon during the late afternoon persisted into the night.
entries.label: 8c030446

entries.text: I was devastated that she could not enjoy an uninterrupted view of the night sky.
entries.label: f2424360

entries.text: Even though it was colder than usual outside the tent,
entries.label: c79279a6

entries.text: Aku mengira… akhirnya sudah ada orang yang memperhatikan introduksiku yang begitu antusias...

entries.speaker: ilot

entries.text: Em … bukan berarti tidak ada orang yang memperhatikannya … Oh ya! Bukankah ada si Puno? !
entries.label: 672c82c1

entries.text: Saat bos baru saja tiba di Orb, aku sudah menyadari kehebatannya dan memutuskan untuk mengikuti bos seumur hidup!

entries.text: Tidak perlu seperti orang biasa yang sadar setelah melihatnya!
entries.label: b5aa772e

entries.label: c29cea14

entries.text: Huh… Sepertinya aku tidak pintar dalam hal promosi…
entries.label: cb23ffad
entries.speaker: car

entries.label: 70b36dd7

entries.label: eb057952

entries.label: 80341dcd
entries.speaker: car

entries.text: Hatimu ternyata memang suka dengan pesawat ruang angkasa!!!
entries.label: b022736b
entries.speaker: car

entries.text: (Tidak, aku hanya tidak bisa mengabaikan panggilan dari hati nuraniku…)

entries.label: 2c275b89

entries.label: af210d69

entries.label: f42f15e5

entries.text: Meh, itu karena aku ingin memfoto banyak benda untuk ditunjukkan ke Hoppe~♪

entries.text: (Hoppe~ Kalau kamu tidak balas suratku, aku akan kirim surat sampai kotak suratmu penuh…)

entries.text: Um… Akhir-akhir ini anakku sering pergi ke tanah tandus sebelah utara…

entries.label: b4ef87a2

entries.label: 94696bb9

entries.text: Meh, coba bicara baik-baik dengannya. Pasti bisa menyelesaikan masalah ini!
entries.label: 9ce5df4e

entries.text: Tapi asalkan memperhatikan lintasan angin, mencari pola, kamu tetap bisa menangkap mangsa.

entries.label: 1561ca00

entries.speaker: ilot

entries.speaker: e-a

entries.text: (Tunggu, bukankah perubahan ekspresi ini … terlalu cepat? !)

entries.speaker: ilot

entries.speaker: ilot

entries.speaker: ilot

entries.speaker: ilot

entries.speaker: e-c

entries.text: Maaf, membuatmu melihat kejadian seperti ini.
entries.speaker: e-c

entries.text: (Wajah seperti ini… Sepertinya tidak masalah jika menjadi idola! )

entries.speaker: ilot

entries.text: Manusia dan Vickers sudah saling membenci dari dulu, perselisihan seperti ini selalu terjadi setiap hari.

entries.speaker: e-c

entries.text: Vickers merasa manusia rakus dan dungu, manusia merasa Vickers licik dan tidak bisa dipercaya.
entries.label: 368bf5c2
entries.speaker: e-c

entries.text: Kedua belah pihak memiliki persepsi buruk antara satu sama lain.
entries.speaker: ilot

entries.text: Tapi kali ini Vickers menjual barang palsu terlebih dahulu… bukankah dia yang salah?

entries.speaker: ilot

entries.text: Mungkin… bagaimana jika pelanggan itu sudah tahu barang itu palsu?

entries.speaker: e-c

entries.text: Membeli produk dengan pemikiran "Mungkin barang palsu juga bisa dipakai dan lebih murah"…
entries.label: 88be749f
entries.speaker: e-c

entries.text: Ternyata menyadari produk berbeda dengan ekspektasi sehingga mau kembalikan barang…

entries.speaker: e-c

entries.text: Huhu, hal seperti ini mungkin terjadi, kan?
entries.label: ce2741c0
entries.speaker: e-c

entries.speaker: ilot

entries.speaker: ilot

entries.label: f0505d17
entries.speaker: e-c
